integrity: The universal sign law is proved analytically; exact-rational computation only replays identities and the explicit witness. Literature comparisons are statement-level and retain a named residual-risk item for incomplete full-text access.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the first depth-one Anderson step on diagonal affine contractions in exact arithmetic.
Coefficient-constrained, safeguarded, nonlinear, finite-precision, and later-step behavior is not classified.
The Jacobi-acceleration comparison was available as metadata and abstract rather than complete readable manuscript text.
title: Standard damping cannot prevent first-step order crossing in Anderson acceleration
